svg.title: The arm heals its own firmware, offline
svg.desc: A real bench run with no internet and nobody touching it. At 0 s, bad firmware v1.7 makes the arm fail its job. At 46 s, the local healer has rolled the firmware back to v1.0. At 72 s, the job runs clean, 663 of 663 frames. At 141 s, it has found the root cause, one line in hcsr04.c.
svg.text: v1.7, the arm fails its job
